rebuttal_or_critique: With inflation at 7.44% and food inflation at 11.51%, the MPC must act as a firm anchor for price stability. I observe that the committee has reached a consensus on maintaining the repo rate at 6.50% and continuing the withdrawal of accommodation. This path strikes the necessary balance between addressing the significant headline inflation breach and supporting the resilient GVA growth of 7.80%. I am satisfied that our collective stance sends a clear, unified message that we are committed to bringing inflation back to the 4.00% target while managing the 120,000 crore liquidity surplus.
